instruction: Change the font size of the title 'Movie List' on Page 3 to 32 pt.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the 'Movie List' title font size to 32 pt on slide 3. The evaluator checks that all runs in the title shape have font size of 406400 EMUs (32 pt * 12700).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the PPTX file from VM with proper postconfig (Ctrl+S to save changes)
Metric function correctly loads PPTX, accesses slide index 2 (Page 3), and finds title shape containing 'Movie List'
Font size comparison logic is correct: converts 32 pt to EMUs using Pt() and checks all runs in all paragraphs
Expected values are semantically correct: slide_index=2 maps to Page 3, title_text='Movie List' and font_size_pt=32 match instruction
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all requirements (correct slide, correct title, correct font size)
Edge cases handled: missing title shape and exceptions return 0.0, all runs checked for consistent font size
Data flow is logical: postconfig saves file -> getter retrieves file -> metric reads and verifies font size
